Job title:  Paediatric Speech Pathologist - Clinic/School Setting - Wollongong 

  Working hours:  Full time or part time 

  Salary offer:  Generous salary offer + professional development support + benefits 

  Location:  Dapto NSW 

   

  About the company:   

 Our client is a leading early intervention multidisciplinary team based in the beautiful Illawarra region. We are a growing team dedicated to providing exceptional support to children aged 0-7 years with developmental delays and disabilities. They are focused on providing essential resources and opportunities to children with developmental vulnerabilities, empowering them to reach their full developmental potential. 

   

  About the role:   

 Our client is looking for a passionate speech pathologist who would love to work either full-time or part-time with flexible hours across schools, early learning services and in their clinic. This role involves providing comprehensive speech pathology services to children of all ages, from early childhood through school age. The successful candidate will assess, diagnose, and treat a wide range of communication and feeding difficulties, empowering children to reach their full potential. 

  Responsibilities:  

 
	  Assessment and Diagnosis:  Conduct thorough assessments to identify communication and feeding challenges, including articulation difficulties, language delays, comprehension issues, stuttering, voice disorders, social skills deficits, and oral motor dysfunction. 
	  Treatment Planning and Implementation:  Develop and implement individualized treatment plans tailored to each child's specific needs and goals, utilizing evidence-based practices. 
	  Therapy Delivery:  Provide direct therapy services in various settings, including our Dapto clinic, preschools, and schools. Sessions are typically 30 minutes long (face-to-face) for both Allied Health Assistant sessions and sessions with qualified therapists. NDIS sessions are billed for 1 hour (including 45 minutes face-to-face therapy and 15 minutes of essential administrative tasks as required by NDIS guidelines). 
	  Collaboration:  Work collaboratively with parents, families, educators, and other professionals to ensure coordinated and effective care. Provide parents with strategies and tasks to support their child's progress at home. 
	  Educational Linkages:  Align therapy goals with the learning needs of each child's school stage, integrating therapy with school-based learning. 
	  Group Sessions and Intensives:  Participate in and contribute to group therapy sessions and holiday intensive programs. 
	  Documentation:  Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and other relevant documentation. For NDIS clients, this includes the required administrative paperwork within the billable hour.      Apply Now

Please Quote Reference Number 17842
- Qualified and experienced applicants wanted
- Remuneration between - $78,000 - $160,000
- Join Connect Resources Pty Ltd in WA, NSW and QLD

Connect Resources Pty Ltd is a specialist provider of Recruitment and Labour Hire Solutions in Western Australia. Our recruitment team have a combined 15+ years' experience recruiting for local roles in Perth and FIFO roles in regional WA, specialising in labour hire and permanent placements for various industries. We also work across New South Wales and Queensland.

We are currently looking to fill the following positions:
- Drainers
- Plumbers
- Fitters
- Welders
- Metal Fabricators
- Carpenters
- Human Resource Advisor/Recruitment Consultant
- ICT Support Engineer
- Accountant
- Office Manager

As Drainer - You must hold a Certificate 2 in Drainage and have at least 3 years' experience in drainage work or a similar position, and also hold a White Card. You will also show experience with drainage work on subdivisions or road projects, pipelaying, reading plans, leading a team, meeting deadlines, and installing sewers and stormwater drains.

As Plumber - You must hold a relevant trade qualification and have at least 2 years' experience in a similar position.

As Fitter - You must hold a relevant trade qualification and have at least 2 years' experience in a similar position.

As Welder - You must hold a relevant trade qualification and have at least 2 years' experience in a similar position.

As Metal Fabricator - You must hold a relevant trade qualification and have at least 2 years' experience in a similar position.

As Carpenter - You must hold a relevant trade qualification and have at least 2 years' experience in a similar position.

The Human Resource Advisor/Recruitment Consultant will play an important role in the delivery of the company's people and culture strategy. You must have at least 3 years' experience in an HR Advisory role and hold a tertiary qualification in Commerce.

As Office Manager - You must have at least 2 years' experience in a similar position.

As ICT Support Engineer - We're also seeking a proactive and technically skilled ICT Support Engineer to join a high performing team. This role is ideal for someone with strong infrastructure and data systems experience who thrives in a fast-paced, high-availability setting.

As part of this position, you'll need to ensure the reliability, stability, and performance of critical systems and services. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple regions in Australia to maintain operational excellence and resolve issues efficiently. You must have at least 2 years' experience in a similar position.

Key Responsibilities:
- Monitor and maintain system performance, ensuring uptime and operational efficiency
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve infrastructure and application-level issues
- Install and configure tools, libraries, and environments
- Support real-time data pipelines and ensure the accuracy and consistency of data flows
- Contribute to the design, implementation, and optimisation of data models and schemas
- Perform QA testing, manage peer-reviewed deployments, and ensure version control
-Maintain secure access to systems and enforce access protocols
- Develop dashboards and reports to surface key operational insights to stakeholders
- Keep accurate documentation of system procedures, configurations, and change logs

Accountant - We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Accountant to manage financial transactions, maintain accurate records, and support overall financial operations. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of accounting principles and practices, and the ability to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

Duties include:
- Prepare and examine financial records, statements, and reports to ensure accuracy and compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
- Maintain general ledger and record financial transactions accurately.
- Manage accounts payable and receivable.
- Perform monthly, quarterly, and annual account reconciliations.
- Assist with budgeting and forecasting activities.
- Prepare tax returns and ensure timely tax filings.
- Conduct internal audits and help implement improvements in financial processes.

You must hold a relevant bachelor's qualification and have at least 2 years' experience in a similar position.

The successful applicants will be offered a remuneration between $78,000 - $160,000.

If you have the right experience, please apply now through the online application form -
https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17842.php

Sponsorship may be available to the right person.
